dataset_name: Cloud Weather Observations – Representative NOAA LCD Data
disclaimer: This dataset is generated using documented statistical properties of NOAA Local Climatological Data (LCD) observations. It preserves realistic meteorological distributions and inter-variable physical constraints but is NOT actual observed data. The pipeline accepts real NOAA CSV files for substitution. When INSAT-3D/3DR data becomes available from MOSDAC, it can be loaded by placing it in the data/raw/ directory.

basis.temperature_model: Seasonal sinusoidal + latitude + elevation lapse rate + diurnal cycle
basis.humidity_model: Monsoon cycle + temperature inverse correlation + coastal effect
basis.wind_model: Weibull distribution (shape=2) with seasonal scale variation
basis.cloud_model: Humidity-dependent ceiling and coverage + fog events

stations: 15 Indian weather stations (actual coordinates from NOAA station list)
temporal_coverage: Jan 2023 – Dec 2024 (hourly observations with realistic gaps)
